paper.title_en: A Minkowski-core black hole with cosmological constant and electric charge
paper.abstract_en: Within a covariant effective Hamiltonian framework, we employ an inverse construction to derive the gravitational Hamiltonian constraint for a Minkowski-core regular black hole without invoking exotic matter. We then extend the constraint by coupling it to a spherically reduced Maxwell field and including a cosmological constant. The resulting charged anti-de Sitter (AdS) and de Sitter (dS) solution is gauge independent and reduces to the Reissner--Nordström--AdS (RN-AdS) black hole when the regularization parameter vanishes. Electric charge and a cosmological constant preserve the Minkowski core: the metric approaches the Minkowski geometry at the center, the Kretschmann scalar vanishes there, and the spacetime exhibits a multi-horizon structure. Focusing on AdS backgrounds, we investigate the black hole thermodynamics. For a regularization parameter below a critical value, the model exhibits a phase transition with consistent signatures across these thermodynamic quantities, demonstrating that Minkowski-core regularization can preserve center regularity while modifying the AdS thermodynamic phase structure relative to the RN-AdS benchmark.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的Minkowski核心带电黑洞解，并研究其热力学，包括相变。理论深度高，方法严谨，具有新颖性，且与黑洞热力学主题高度相关。
decision.title_zh: 具有宇宙学常数和电荷的Minkowski核心黑洞
decision.abstract_zh: 在协变有效哈密顿框架内，我们采用逆构造方法来推导Minkowski核心正则黑洞的引力哈密顿约束，而无需引入奇异物质。然后，我们通过将该约束与球对称约化的Maxwell场耦合并加入宇宙学常数来扩展该约束。得到的带电反德西特（AdS）和德西特（dS）解是规范无关的，并且当正则化参数为零时，它退化为Reissner-Nordström-AdS（RN-AdS）黑洞。电荷和宇宙学常数保持Minkowski核心不变：度规在中心接近Minkowski几何，Kretschmann标量在该处消失，并且时空表现出多视界结构。专注于AdS背景，我们研究了黑洞热力学。对于低于临界值的正则化参数，该模型表现出相变，且这些热力学量之间具有一致的签名，表明Minkowski核心正则化可以在保持中心正则性的同时，相对于RN-AdS基准改变AdS热力学相结构。
